tools.name: search_nursing_homes
tools.description: Searches the 14,000+ CMS-certified nursing homes by name, city or state and returns each match's CCN, name, city, state, certified beds, CMS overall star rating, whether an FHA-insured HUD 232 loan is matched (active, past or none) and its SNF Register page. Use the CCN with get_nursing_home.

tools.name: get_state_nursing_homes
tools.description: A state's (or the US) nursing home roll-up: CMS-certified facilities and beds, median occupancy, star-rating spread, median nurse hours and turnover, for-profit, nonprofit and government counts, chain share, PE and REIT flags, recent ownership changes, Special Focus count, and HUD 232 loan activity.
